UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for Flashlight Pro including default mode and strobe frequency

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns these settings

defaultMode.description: Default mode for flashlight startup (NORMAL, SOS, STROBE)

strobeFrequency.description: Flash frequency for strobe mode in Hz (1 to 20)

hapticFeedback.description: Whether tactile vibration feedback is enabled for buttons

screenLightColor.description: Hex color string for screen light fallback

screenBrightness.description: Brightness float between 0.0 and 1.0 for screen illumination

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Must be server timestamp.

updatedAt.description: Update timestamp. Must be server timestamp.

FlashlightLog.title: FlashlightLog
FlashlightLog.description: Activity log entry tracking flashlight activation sessions

action.description: Action performed (ON, OFF, SOS, STROBE, SCREEN)

durationSeconds.description: Duration the flashlight stayed on in seconds

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Must be server timestamp.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingsId}.description: User specific flashlight configuration and preferences

/users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: User specific history of flashlight activations
